name: Improved Dazing Bash (Combat)
body:
You have learned to truly bully an opponent with your shield.

Prerequisite(s): Dazing Bash, Improved Shield Bash, Shield Focus, Base attack bonus +9.

Benefit(s): When the target of your shield rush feat fails their saving throw, in addition to being dazed until the beginning of your next turn they also recalculate their initiative as though they had rolled a 1. This does not let their turn occur a second time in the round.
